pending-clause.answer: §2002:8.4.1.1 is restructured in 2023 (the uniqueness cases are rewritten and 2023 lists 'a paragraph-name referenced within its own section' among the cases needing no qualification), and 2002 has TYPEDEF/TYPE wording. For paragraph names 2002 reaches the same result through the rule itself (need not be qualified within the same section) plus 8.4.1.1 item 6 (qualification by the section-name); nothing in the changed text alters which duplicates are barred. Scope and the pb466 / para-dup evidence at 2002 are unchanged.
